falseSynonyms.zh: 國際上不一定等於全世界 internationally 表示跨越多個國家，但不保證覆蓋全球。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A company may operate internationally without operating all over the world.

falseSynonyms.zh: 海外不等於全球 overseas 只表示在本國以外，可能只涉及一個或幾個國家。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The firm has overseas offices, but that does not mean it operates worldwide.

falseSynonyms.zh: 國外不等於世界各地 abroad 表示在外國，通常從某個人的本國視角出發，不表示全球範圍。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She studied abroad, but not all over the world.

falseSynonyms.zh: 到處不一定等於全球 everywhere 的範圍由上下文決定，可以只是一個城市、建築或網站。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The posters were everywhere in the city, not necessarily worldwide.

falseSynonyms.zh: 普遍成立不等於全球分布 universally 常表示人人都認同／適用，而不是地理上遍及世界各地。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The rule is universally accepted, but that does not describe where something is located.

falseSynonyms.zh: 跨國不等於全世界 across countries 表示涉及多個國家，但範圍可以很有限。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The study was conducted across several countries, not worldwide.
